Every contest of the November 8, 2022 election, by parish and by precinct, as the results site's download offers it; the workbook's own line reads 'Election Date: 2022-11-08'. The Secretary marks this election's results official (ElectionDates.htm). The vote rows stored are this workbook's.

Every contest of the December 10, 2022 election, by parish and by precinct, as the results site's download offers it; the workbook's own line reads 'Election Date: 2022-12-10'. The Secretary marks this election's results official (ElectionDates.htm). The vote rows stored are this workbook's.
gaps: Louisiana declares a lone qualified candidate elected and prints no contest, so such offices are not in the results files and are not stored.
The other contests of the December 10, 2022 ballot
70 contests on the December ballot are not runoffs of a November contest stored here (measure 70). They are not part of the November general election, so they are not stored.
